title: Beyond Good Intentions: Reporting the Research Landscape of NLP for Social Good
reasoning: The paper provides a comprehensive overview and progress report of the NLP for Social Good field by mapping research to UN Sustainable Development Goals. While it discusses societal implications and includes 'Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions' (SDG 16) as a category, it does not evaluate religion or benchmark the moral and ethical reasoning of the models themselves. The ethical considerations section is limited to procedural disclosure.
